about: Gary D. Eisenstat is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. He works at Ogletree, Deakins, Nash, Smoak & Stewart, P.C., located in Dallas, Texas, and provides legal services for issues involving Employment Litigation: Defense, Business Litigation and Alternative Dispute Resolution to the surrounding community.
Gary Eisenstat completed legal studies at Boston University School of Law and graduated with the class of 1985. Gary Eisenstat passed the bar in 1985.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.
